title: Machine Learning-Driven Virtual Bidding with Electricity Market Efficiency Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2104.02754v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a machine learning-driven portfolio optimization framework for virtual bidding in electricity markets considering both risk constraint and price sensitivity. The algorithmic trading strategy is developed from the perspective of a proprietary trading firm to maximize profit. A recurrent neural network-based Locational Marginal Price (LMP) spread forecast model is developed by leveraging the inter-hour dependencies of the market clearing algorithm. The LMP spread sensitivity with respect to net virtual bids is modeled as a monotonic function with the proposed constrained gradient boosting tree. We leverage the proposed algorithmic virtual bid trading strategy to evaluate both the profitability of the virtual bid portfolio and the efficiency of U.S. wholesale electricity markets. translated_title: 机器学习驱动的虚拟竞价与电力市场效率分析
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个机器学习驱动的电力市场虚拟竞价投资组合优化框架，同时考虑了风险约束和价格敏感性。该算法交易策略从自营交易公司的角度出发，以实现利润最大化为目标。通过利用市场出清算法的小时间依赖性，开发了一种基于循环神经网络的节点边际电价（LMP）价差预测模型。LMP价差对净虚拟投标的敏感性通过所提出的约束梯度提升树被建模为单调函数。我们利用所提出的算法虚拟投标交易策略来评估虚拟投标组合的盈利能力以及美国批发电力市场的效率。对PJM、ISO-NE和CAISO的全面实证分析表明，所提出的虚拟投标组合优化策略...（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑风险约束和价格敏感性的机器学习驱动虚拟竞价投资组合优化框架，并利用该策略评估了虚拟投标组合的盈利能力及美国批发电力市场的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a machine learning-driven virtual bidding portfolio optimization framework considering risk constraints and price sensitivity, and leverages it to evaluate the profitability of virtual bid portfolios and the efficiency of U.S. wholesale electricity markets.
